defects.description: Description: one hand on the hip. L wrist→L hip dist2D=0.568, R wrist→R hip dist2D=0.780 (threshold <0.25). NEITHER hand on hip. L arm has leftShoulder=-30 (abduction ~?) + leftElbow=65 — upper arm not horizontal, forearm not folded to hip.

Description: the other touching the wall. Body sideways (globalRoll=10) so wall is to the side/behind. L wrist z=0.077 (slightly forward), R wrist z=0.336 (forward). Neither wrist clearly on wall (would need z near 0 or negative for back-wall contact, or significant x magnitude for side-wall). shoulderFwdR=8 (positive = BEHIND per CORRECTED convention) — R arm only slightly backward, not reaching wall behind.

failing_tests.assertion: one wrist z <= 0.0 (back-wall contact) or shoulderFwdR significantly positive (backward extension)

regression_risk: medium-high — six simultaneous joint changes. Wall position relative to sideways body is ambiguous; shoulderFwdR=25 backward extension may not actually contact wall. Integrator should verify via test render.
rationale: Six coordinated changes for one-hand-on-hip (L) + one-hand-on-wall (R). Per CORRECTED sign convention shoulderFwd +=behind, -=forward. L hand to hip: (1) leftShoulder -30→-55 (raise upper arm to ~80deg abduction, elbow approaches shoulder height). (2) leftElbow 65→100 (deep flexion, forearm folds down toward hip). (3) shoulderFwdL 2→-10 (slight forward, hand in front of body for hip contact). R hand to wall: (4) shoulderFwdR 8→25 (increase backward extension, R arm reaches behind toward wall). (5) rightShoulder -50→-25 (reduce outward abduction, more natural arm position for backward reach). (6) rightElbow 20→45 (slight flexion for hand to reach wall surface). spine=-15 (PR-v3), globalRoll=10 (body sideways), globalTwist=-15, hipAbductR=-15 (R leg crossing) preserved.
